summary: folder-lint preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style hex identifiers and string-lookup dictionaries; it downloads a Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts the bun binary to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it with a sibling file `math_init.js` as its argument. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line Bun-bundled blob (banner `// @bun @bun-cjs`) with numeric-encoded string tables and mangled identifiers. The package's advertised purpose is a folder-lint library, and the trivial `lib/` code has no relationship to Bun; the alternate-runtime fetch exists solely to execute the opaque bundled payload outside Node's reach during `npm install`. The install-time execution path fires automatically on default install via the preinstall lifecycle hook.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
